dataset: SCH RAG test set (frozen before any v2 tuning)
provenance: Information needs, questions (five languages, written natively per language, not translated word by word), gold evidence quotes, relevance grades and reference answers were drafted by an AI assistant (Claude) by reading the frozen public corpus directly, NOT from any retriever output. Other relevant documents were found by exhaustive text search over the whole corpus (scripts/rag_v2/build_testset.py) and graded by the same assistant. NOT reviewed by a person (review_status draft_unreviewed); see docs/research/rag-v2/HUMAN-REVIEW-CHECKLIST.md.

grades.1: the document is on the same need and gives part of it or the general rule without the asked detail (partial)

evidence.quote: 그 과목의 성적 및 교과목 이수를 인정하지 않음(학점인정 불가)

needs.reference_answer: No. If you attend and sit the exams of a course you did not register for (for example by adding your name to the attendance list), neither the grade nor the credit is recognised.

재수강 교과목의 성적은 B+을 초과할 수 없다

needs.reference_answer: A retaken course can earn at most B+. Retakes are allowed for courses with C+ or below, up to 3 courses within 6 credits, only in the second registration period.

needs.reference_answer: Hakseongsa / Hyangseol 2 move-out: first period 11-12 December 2026, second 14-19 December, 9:30-17:00. Students not staying for the vacation must leave within these periods.

evidence.quote: 호실키 미반납 및 분실 시 : 입사보증금을 지급하지 아니함

needs.reference_answer: If you do not return or lose your room key, the dormitory deposit is not refunded.

evidence.quote: 청소 상태 불량한 경우 해당 호실 이용자 다음 학기 기숙사 입사 불가
청소 불량 시 벌점이 부여됩니다

needs.reference_answer: Poor cleaning at move-out gives penalty points, and residents of a badly cleaned room cannot move into the dormitory next semester.

q.ko: 퇴사할 때 방 청소를 제대로 안 하면 어떻게 돼요?

q.zh-CN: 退宿时如果没有把房间打扫干净，会怎么样？

evidence.quote: 위반 시 벌점 5점 부여

needs.reference_answer: At the weekly fridge check (Wednesdays from 21:00), prohibited items or food not kept in the required containers can be thrown away that Friday, and a violation gives 5 penalty points.

evidence.quote: First determine whether your approved period of stay is ending. If so, submit an extension-of-stay application before expiration.
replacing the plastic card alone does not extend status

needs.reference_answer: Not necessarily: if the card date reflects the end of your permitted stay, apply for an extension of stay before it expires; replacing the plastic card alone does not extend your status.

q.ko: 외국인등록증 만료일이 다음 달인데 카드만 새로 발급받으면 되나요?

needs.grading_notes: 4650e940 states an extension must be filed before expiry, without the card-versus-status distinction (partial).

evidence.quote: Academic-status changes can affect your D-2 status. Contact your university and immigration service promptly.
For changes in academic status such as leave of absence or graduation, your school is required to report the change to the competent immigration office.

needs.reference_answer: Do not assume so. Graduation changes your academic status; the school reports it to immigration, which reviews your D-2 status and may give departure guidance. Contact the university and immigration promptly (for example about changing to D-10).

q.ko: 한 학기 일찍 졸업하는데 외국인등록증에 적힌 날짜까지 한국에 있어도 되나요?

q.id: Saya lulus satu semester lebih cepat. Bolehkah saya tetap di Korea sampai tanggal di kartu ARC saya?

evidence.quote: existing cards generally remain valid without replacement solely because a new card design or IC chip was introduced

needs.reference_answer: Yes, generally. Existing cards remain valid; the introduction of a new card design or IC chip alone does not require a replacement.

q.ko: 새 디자인 외국인등록증이 나왔다던데, 제 예전 카드도 계속 쓸 수 있나요?

evidence.quote: Supporters can explain processes and help prepare or route materials, but government immigration authorities make legal determinations.

needs.reference_answer: No. Global Supporters can explain the process and help prepare or route documents, but only the immigration authorities decide on ARC and visa-extension applications.

evidence.quote: must leave the country within 15 days of receiving permission for the leave of absence
외국인 학생의 경우, 학교의 휴학허가를 받은 날로부터 15일 이내 출국해야 함

needs.reference_answer: International students who take a leave of absence must leave Korea within 15 days of the school approving the leave.

q.ko: 휴학하면 한국에 계속 있어도 되나요, 아니면 출국해야 하나요?
q.en: If I take a leave of absence, can I stay in Korea or do I have to leave?
q.id: Kalau saya cuti kuliah, apakah saya boleh tetap di Korea atau harus pulang?

q.zh-CN: 如果我休学，可以继续留在韩国吗？还是必须出境？

needs.grading_notes: Answered only by the two hub guides (a case where retrieving a guide is correct); 21e3e650 lists leave of absence as a risk to student status (partial).

evidence.quote: if already expired, urgently contact Immigration Contact Center 1345

needs.reference_answer: An extension must be requested before expiry; if your stay has already expired, contact the Immigration Contact Center 1345 urgently (and the international office).

q.ko: 체류기간이 어제 끝났는데 연장 신청을 안 했어요. 어떡하죠?
q.en: My D-2 stay expired yesterday and I never applied for an extension. What should I do?
q.id: Izin tinggal D-2 saya habis kemarin dan saya belum mengajukan perpanjangan. Harus bagaimana?

needs.grading_notes: d60bc363 states an extension must be obtained before the permitted stay is exceeded, nothing on an already expired stay (partial).

evidence.quote: A. No. Immigration approval is required for a change of status when applicable.

needs.reference_answer: No. A job offer does not change your visa; a change of status of stay must be approved by immigration before you start the new activity.

q.ko: 졸업 전에 회사에서 합격 통보를 받았는데 비자가 자동으로 바뀌나요?

evidence.quote: typically 3.5 × 4.5 cm

needs.reference_answer: One recent passport-style colour photo, typically 3.5 x 4.5 cm, taken within six months.

evidence.quote: 1회 부여 체류기간의 상한: 6개월
Can be extended in 6-month increments, up to a maximum of 2 years.

needs.reference_answer: The job-seeker (D-10-1) status is granted for at most 6 months at a time and can be extended in 6-month steps up to 2 years in total.

evidence.quote: 시간제취업 허가 위반자에 대해서는 졸업후 구직(D-10) 자격 변경 제한

needs.reference_answer: It can be restricted: students who violated the part-time work permit rules are restricted from changing to the job-seeking (D-10) status after graduation (2021-era guidebook text); the university notice also lists disadvantages in visa changes.
